why_receipts_remain_valid: The production receipts record the outputs of the producer f6eaa1a8 (exact bytes archived here), which both audits judged arithmetically sound for the fixed task scopes. Both fixes change only how stored or malformed input is validated; no sieve, residue, libmpdec or digest path changed. The current verifier reproduces the stored rows exactly on replay (type-exact canonical JSON), and the guarded coverage check accepts all 446 authentic receipts with their original producer stamp. Receipts were never rewritten (evidence/receipts-sha256.json).
